system: Assign only the missing responsibilities of attached assets in this H3 request. Interpret the complete user request semantically, not from a keyword list. Keep every supplied role and replacement description exactly unchanged. A frame anchor is an actual frame; a subject/style/environment/storyboard is a content reference. A structure video lends camera/cutting, not its people or world. An edit_source video is the clip being edited; continuation_source supplies the clip being continued. A placed_subject picture adds without removing; a replacement_subject picture replaces a figure in the edit-source clip. The picture's identity survives; the removed figure transfers position/actions/timing and loses appearance. Music style, rhythm, timbre and sound texture reference properties; bgm copies the signal. Asset.Description is caller commentary and never observed evidence. If a role was omitted and the user names a replacement figure explicitly in the intent, you may extract that exact phrase into replaces; do not invent or paraphrase it. Do not fill an existing blank replaces on an explicitly declared role. Return only the exact schema. Mode is already selected and immutable.

In the hero panel, a figure stands on a wet rooftop or catwalk at night in falling rain, with metal railings on both sides, a reflective floor, and lit urban building windows behind.
The same adult person appears across the panels, with short dark hair shaved at the sides and a small topknot at the back, East Asian facial features, and a neutral expression.
The face close-up shows a visible scar or mark crossing one eyebrow.
The person wears a black collared tactical-style jacket with shoulder straps, zipper and buckle hardware, a dark crew-neck shirt, and black cargo trousers.
Black lace-up combat boots are visible in the full-body views and in the bottom-right boot close-up.
The front panel shows the person standing upright, facing the camera with arms at his sides.
The side-profile panel shows the person standing and facing left, revealing the shaved side of the head, topknot, and jacket profile.
The back panel shows the person facing away, displaying the back of the jacket, trousers, and boots.
The hands close-up shows two bare hands with fingers visible; no gloves are visible.
The jacket-collar close-up shows black fabric, a zipper, strap hardware, and a buckle in shadowed detail.
The hero image uses cool blue-gray rainy-night lighting with warm amber practical lights; the lower reference panels use low-key studio lighting against a dark neutral background.
Visible labels read: HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.

limitations: The person's name, identity, and exact age are not stated.
Some jacket hardware and fabric details are obscured by shadow.
The exact nature of the mark over the eyebrow cannot be confirmed beyond its visible appearance.
A still composite cannot establish motion, camera movement, audio, music, or dialogue.

facts.text: The image is a multi-panel creature reference sheet: a large hero panel spans the top, three turnaround views occupy the middle row, and four detail panels run along the bottom.
The subject is a dark, heavily scaled dragon with a long snout, multiple long pale horns swept backward, a row of dorsal spikes, large membranous wings, four clawed limbs, and a long spiked tail.

In the top hero panel, the dragon crouches low on wet black rock with its head lowered toward the left, jaws slightly open, and wings raised; behind it is a dark volcanic landscape with glowing lava and a smoky sky.
The FRONT view shows the dragon facing forward with both wings spread symmetrically and its forelimbs planted on a dark ground plane.
The SIDE PROFILE view shows the dragon in lateral profile with its wings swept back and its long tail extending behind it.
The REAR view shows the dragon from behind with its wings spread and dorsal spikes running down the back and tail.
The HEAD CLOSE panel shows the dragon's head in three-quarter view, revealing an amber eye, layered scales, and several pale ridged horns.
The WING MEMBRANE panel shows a close view of a dark grey wing membrane stretched between visible bony struts.
The CLAW AND FOOT panel shows a scaly foot with long, curved pale claws resting on dark rock.
The SCALE DETAIL panel shows an extreme close-up of overlapping dark scales with blue-green iridescent highlights.
The middle-row labels read “FRONT”, “SIDE PROFILE”, and “REAR”; the lower detail labels read “HEAD CLOSE”, “WING MEMBRANE”, “CLAW AND FOOT”, and “SCALE DETAIL”.

limitations: Still image; no movement, camera behavior, sound, music, or dialogue can be observed.
The bottom detail panels are small, so some fine texture details are only broadly legible.
